decider: Planning Commission Chairman signs final minor plat; Planning Commission reviews at a regular meeting (Director screens)

public_notice.cite: No adjoining-owner, sign or published notice in Ch. 140 for minors; preliminary presented at PC regular meeting § 140-17.C; Chairman may sign final without full Commission § 140-21.D(1); waivers need certified-mail notice § 140-46.B(2)(a)

cumulative_cap.counted_from: single lot, tract or parcel existing as of April 1, 1995, all at once or lot by lot

perc_season.months: Feb-Apr (wet-season testing; estimate from State rule)
perc_season.cite: COMAR 26.04.02.04B; State Summary section 2; County perc fees Code § 131-3

county_fees.cite: Res. 695 pp.10-12 and Code § 131-3. 3-lot = $500 subdivision + $250 simplified FSD + $500 FCP + $250 perc per subdivision site; 7-lot = $1,400 subdivision (assumes +$300 after lot 4) + $250 FSD + $500 FCP + $250 perc. Excludes recording, building excise tax ($5,000/dwelling), stormwater permit, consultants. Estimate.

forest_conservation.cite: § 140-59, § 140-63, Table 140-64; Res. 695 p.12 (exempt if wholly in Critical Area or under 40,000 sf)

studies_required: stormwater/erosion plan if over 5,000 sf disturbed
Critical Area report and buffer plan if within 1,000 ft of tidal water

access.cite: Att. 2 (lot width at front lot line, local road 100 ft; minor collector 140; major collector 200); § 140-26.A(2)(c), C(1)(f) (one interior lot by easement; two lots may share driveway); flag/panhandle not addressed
